review_method: Sequential source-first semantic review across the exact 29 dimensions. Null tiṇai, poet and speaker metadata remain reviewed-empty; printed macro-division and major-division headings remain navigation only.

literary_domain.note: Akanāṉūṟu is treated as Akam work context; this is not inferred from the poem body.

tinai.note: The canonical record has no printed tiṇai value; printed macro-division and major-division headings are not classifiers.

speaker.note: The canonical record has no printed speaker value; none is reconstructed.

poet.note: The canonical record has no printed poet attribution.

landscape_environment.note: Exact land, spring, arid-route, sea and forest wording retained without reconstructing a conventional tiṇai.

season_weather_time.note: Exact heat/sun and strong-wind wording retained without calendrical expansion.

flora.note: Exact garland, bamboo-like, tree, paddy, grass and முருங்கை flower wording retained without modern botanical identification.

fauna.note: Exact beetle, horse and elephant wording retained without modern zoological identification.

people_social_roles.note: Exact மழவர், நெடுவேள் ஆவி and தோழி role wording retained without historical identity reconstruction.

relationships.note: Exact separation-promise, friend address and departure wording retained as poem-level relationship evidence.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Exact non-separation promise, forgetting and bodily loosening language retained without psychological modernization.

food_subsistence.note: Exact நெல் wording retained as subsistence evidence without quantified inference.

clothing_ornaments_adornment.note: Exact கண்ணி, ஒண்கழல் and பொலங்கலம் adornment wording retained without material reconstruction.

weapons_warfare.note: Exact நற்போர் wording retained without reconstructing a historical battle.

mobility_transport.note: Exact driven-horse wording retained without route reconstruction.

economy.note: Exact பொலங்கலம் / வெறுக்கை wealth wording retained without quantified economic inference.

polity_political_life.note: நெடுவேள் ஆவி remains an unresolved source political/person form; no external identity is assigned.

communities_social_groups.note: மழவர் is retained as an unresolved source group expression without ethnographic expansion.

religion_ritual.note: Exact முருகன் sacred/deity wording retained without doctrinal expansion.

values_ethical_concepts.note: The stated non-separation promise and question of forgetting are retained as source-level evaluative language.

body_health.note: Exact பணைத்தோள் bodily wording retained without medical modernization.

named_entities.note: மழவர், முருகன், நெடுவேள் ஆவி and பொதினி remain unresolved source forms; no external identity is assigned.

tinai.note: The canonical record has no printed tiṇai value; printed macro-division and major-division headings are not classifiers.

poet.note: The canonical record has no printed poet attribution.

flora.note: Exact plant wording for வாழை, பலவு, சாந்தம், வேய் and வேங்கை retained without modern botanical identification.

fauna.note: Exact கடுவன் and generic விலங்கு wording retained without modern zoological identification.

people_social_roles.note: Exact தந்தை and காவலர் role wording retained without institutional reconstruction.
